highlights: WiWU ARK 45W Type-C PD GaN Fast Charger Wi-U035 USB-C (UK Plug)
Streamline your charging with the powerful and portable WiWU Stars 45W GaN Charger. This is the versatile, high-speed power solution you've been waiting for.

Engineered with cutting-edge Gallium Nitride (GaN) technology, it delivers a massive 45W of Power Delivery from a remarkably compact body, perfect for fast-charging your MacBook Air, iPad Pro, or the latest smartphones.
The advanced chip intelligently identifies your device and automatically adjusts the charging current for optimal speed and safety.

Available in multiple global plug versions, the Stars 45W is the perfect, powerful companion for a streamlined and efficient workspace.
